bagPolicy.summary: Black Cat searches all bags at the door. It hasn't published size limits, so bring only what you need.
bagPolicy.quote: Bags will be searched upon entry.

parking.summary: Black Cat partners with SpotHero, so you can reserve a parking spot in advance on the club's SpotHero page. The club is also three blocks from the U Street/Cardozo Metro station.
parking.quote: We have partnered with SpotHero, a convenient service to reserve parking in advance.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Black Cat. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The bars take debit cards, credit cards and cash, and there's an ATM on site. Apple Pay, digital wallets, Venmo and PayPal aren't accepted at the bar.
prohibited: Venmo, PayPal and other peer-to-peer payments
concessions.quote: The Black Cat accepts debit cards, credit cards, and cash for bar purchases.

accessibility.summary: Black Cat hasn't published accessibility details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

reEntry.summary: Black Cat hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office is open whenever the club is open, and cash tickets bought there have no service fee; online sales go through Etix. Everyone needs a valid government-issued ID. Shows are open to all ages, but guests under 18 should come with an adult, and anyone without valid ID gets a no-alcohol hand stamp.
ticketPickup.quote: Because we welcome concert goers of all ages we require a valid government issued ID from ALL patrons.

gates.summary: Door times change by event, so check the show listing or your ticket before you go.
gates.quote: Our hours are subject to change depending on the event - please check our website or your ticket for door times.
